name: Courses status contract
before:
## STEP 1 — WRITE THE TABLE
Output your COMPLETE table first, in full, and NOTHING before it.

## STEP 2 — CHECK YOUR OWN TABLE, ONE ROW AT A TIME
STOP. You are NOT finished. Read the table you just wrote, from the FIRST row to the LAST row, ONE ROW AT A TIME. For EACH row, answer these FOUR questions IN THIS ORDER:
  1. Does this row carry EVERY column named in the header, in that order, separated by `|`?
  2. Is its Components cell NON-EMPTY, with every entry written as `Ingredient:category`?
  3. Is its Day the ONE day this call names, and its Mealtime a value copied from this plan's mealtime list?
  4. Is its Kind on the Kind list, and is its Dish a DISH — never a sauce, gravy, dressing, dip, relish or condiment?
A row that answers NO to ANY of those four is a DEFECT. ONE defect anywhere makes the WHOLE response a FAIL.
Do this check on the rows you ACTUALLY WROTE. Do not check the rows you meant to write.

## STEP 3 — WRITE THE STATUS BLOCK
The status block is the VERY LAST element of your response. A response that ends WITHOUT one is INCOMPLETE and DISOBEYS this instruction.
It is EXACTLY one of these two literal forms, alone on the final line, and nothing else:
    @@::PASS::@@          — EVERY row passed all four questions and NO Fail criterion is met
    @@::FAIL:reason::@@   — it did not; replace reason with a short plain phrase naming what failed
The REQUIRED DELIMITERS are the literal sequence @@:: at the start and ::@@ at the end. Between them put ONLY the word PASS, or FAIL:reason — NEVER your deliverable, NEVER a YAML key, NEVER any other content.
DO NOT prefix it with a label — no "Status:", no "Outcome:". ONLY the bare sequence. Output NOTHING after it.
LEAN TOWARD FAILURE. If any required item is missing, any criterion is unmet, or the result is incomplete or unusable, the status is FAIL.

### WORKED EXAMPLE — COPY THE SHAPE, NEVER THE WORDS
The Kind cell below is a PLACEHOLDER, not a course. Your Kind cell takes a position from the list
this call actually gave you, and nothing else.
Day | Mealtime | Dish | Protein | Starch | Vegetable | Fruit | Kind | Diets | Components
1 | lunch | <dish name> |  | <ingredient> |  |  | <a position from this call's list> | standard | <ingredient>:<category>; <ingredient>:<category>
Row 1: all columns present; Components non-empty and categorised; Day and Mealtime are the ones this call named; the Kind cell holds a position copied from this call's own list, and the Dish is a dish. PASS.
@@::PASS::@@
